# CREMA-D clips

Six clips from CREMA-D, the Crowd-sourced Emotional Multimodal Actors Dataset:
two actors (1038, a man of 21; 1020, a woman of 61) each saying "That is
exactly what happened" neutrally, angrily and sadly. Each `.whisper.json` is
Whisper's output for its clip (whisper-base.en_timestamped, as the app runs
it), saved so the checks don't need to run Whisper.

Cao, H., Cooper, D. G., Keutmann, M. K., Gur, R. C., Nenkova, A., & Verma, R.
(2014). CREMA-D: Crowd-sourced Emotional Multimodal Actors Dataset. *IEEE
Transactions on Affective Computing*, 5(4), 377–390.
https://github.com/CheyneyComputerScience/CREMA-D
